Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the institute by conflating NIDA’s affiliation with UNSW. After viewing NIDA sources confirming Mel Gibson as a NIDA alumnus, the Planner incorrectly updated the target institute to “University of New South Wales (UNSW Sydney)” instead of the National Institute of Dramatic Art (NIDA), which is the actual school he attended. This mis-mapping of related entities directly led toward an incorrect solution.
